question: At fixed native parameters and actual full-batch support, is the frozen conditional identity auxiliary finite, differentiated through intended native parameter blocks, and different between shared and separated component responsibilities?
prerequisites: Successful separately admitted exact CPU numerical QA of the chosen core
One narrow native binding with authenticated complete TRAIN teacher and source-reviewed physical ownership/custody/update bounds
Exact source/runtime/bank-size/mask/initialization/reduction/cap binding and separate root release
gradient_evaluations: J_K auxiliary parameter and slot-logit gradients
J_K_sep auxiliary parameter and slot-logit gradients

frozen_objective.serving: Unchanged/count-free; TRAIN teacher counts/patterns are not serving inputs

representative_scope: One predeclared full native batch, fixed before output inspection. Actual negative/mask RNG provenance must be recorded; no claim it replays the census or a prior fit without exact stream evidence. A naturally atypical/null/failed batch is retained, not replaced or rerun.
receipts: Exact source/runtime/teacher/input/record/negative/support/query digests and actual per-side n,k,r/joint counts
Actual slot/logit magnitudes, finite losses and finite gradients
Raw per-stratum slot-logit gradient L1/L2/max and forced exact-zero counts; retain categorical and genuine/coupled strata
Parameter-block gradient norms for target/J_K/J_K_sep; auxiliary-to-target ratios and cosines only for nonzero denominators
Norms/maxima of J_K minus J_K_sep gradients from the SAME graph/parameters; numerical agreement on forced-counterpart strata under unchanged fixed rule
Inclusive setup/packing/native forward/three reverse passes/metadata wall and sampled RSS/CUDA peaks; actual group/slot dispatch counts and observed terminal/output custody
interpretation: A finite/nonzero native gradient confirms signal and gradient connectivity at this initialization and mask only; it establishes no predictive gain or learned association.

A nonzero shared/separated gradient difference can occur only in two-variable queries in exact arithmetic. Counts make that possible, not inevitable: equal/cancelling component laws can yield zero. Record a natural zero honestly without changing logits, mixture weights, objective scale or initialization.
Separate fitted models would conflate association with changed marginals/native transfer; this diagnostic evaluates identical fixed tensors.
Native BCE and all required native work remain even for forced auxiliary cases. Zero conditional identity gradients do not imply zero target/classification learning.
All-query denominator and positive/negative means can dilute the signal. Report raw gradients; the fixed absolute engineering tolerance is not a lower bound on useful gradient mass.
Three reverse passes intentionally measure this diagnostic workload, not one ordinary training step or a complete update/VALID schedule. Full schedule resource qualification remains separate.
